thread:
Maya R.: quick async update on the new open-model batch (Orchid-Lite, Zephyr-XS, Navis-variant). putting everything here so folks can pick up actions.

Maya R.: summary — Orchid-Lite: license OK (Apache compatible), perf baseline looks fine but tail latency spikes at >1024 tokens. Zephyr-XS: legal flagged model weights provenance, need one doc from upstream. Navis-variant: tokenizer mismatches on some Unicode edge cases.

Leo N.: noted. can you paste the perf numbers? helps me decide canary size.

Maya R.: rough numbers (local staging, 16k batch window): Orchid-Lite median latency 85ms, p95 240ms, p99 420ms for 1024 seq; when quantized 4-bit p50 ~70ms but p99 jumps to 610ms. Zephyr-XS median 120ms but p99 900ms (needs profile). Navis-variant median 95ms, tokenization errors ~0.4% on our sample set.

Suresh K.: re: tokenizer — I can take Navis. will run tokenization diff and file a tiny CR with a fallback. ETA end of day tomorrow.

Claire D.: I'll own the Zephyr legal ask — looping in legal@redwood to get provenance doc. pinging legal via email now.

Maya R.: thanks. for rollout plan I'm proposing: 1) triage Navis tokenizer CR (Suresh) 2) legal sign-off for Zephyr (Claire) 3) Orchid perf tune + kernel sweep (Leo) 4) small canary (5% traffic, 1 region) once 1-3 pass.

Leo N.: kernel sweep: I want to run a short kernel matrix on staging (A100 vs 4090) with sequence length buckets [128,512,1024,2048]. I'll schedule tomorrow morning. canary target next Tue if no regressions. ops-bot, can you tentatively reserve staging slots?

ops-bot: staging reservation created: 2026-04-06 09:00 - 12:00 UTC; cluster: staging-gpu-2; reservation id r-622345. :white_check_mark:

Claire D.: legal replied — need a checksum and model card link from upstream for Zephyr. I sent template. aiming to close by EOD Thu if upstream responds.

Maya R.: small manual QA needed: could someone run the 200 prompt eval (long-form + code) against Orchid-quant and Orchid-fp16 and drop the outputs in /s3/redwood-model-evals/orchid/quick-audit ? here's the curl for perf harness:

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"orchid-lite","input":"<your prompt>","max_tokens":512}'
```

Suresh K.: I can run the 200 prompts against Navis and Orchid quant later tonight and upload results.

Leo N.: I'll do the kernel sweep and attach perf artifacts to the canary ticket. also will check memory fragmentation for long sequences.

Maya R.: ownership summary: Suresh -> Navis tokenizer CR + eval uploads; Claire -> Zephyr legal doc + follow-up with legal; Leo -> Orchid kernel sweep + canary schedule; Maya -> overall rollout coord + gating checklist.

Claire D.: small ask — can we add an explicit eval for embeddings shape sanity? Zephyr had a variant where embeddings shape changed; that would block prod.

Maya R.: good call. adding embeddings shape test to the 200 prompt harness.

Leo N.: eyes on this tomorrow, will flag in canary ticket if anything critical.

Maya R.: thanks all :pray: I'll update the model-catalog metadata draft after the legal/CR bits land. if anyone hits a blocker call out here and I'll escalate.

Suresh K.: noted, will post CR link when ready.

ops-bot: canary job created: ticket #ML-1287, tentative start 2026-04-07 14:00 UTC, owners: Leo N., Maya R.
